questions.prompt: Which overall plan matches the stack approach for Implement Queue using Stacks?

choices.label: Transfer all inputs onto a nonempty output stack before every pop.
choices.feedback: Newer inputs would sit above older queued values and break FIFO order.

choices.label: Declare the queue empty whenever either stack is empty.
choices.feedback: The queue is empty only when both stacks contain no values.

choices.label: Push into an input stack. When the output stack is empty, transfer all inputs to reverse their order; pop and peek from the output stack.
choices.feedback: That matches the selected approach. Push into an input stack. When the output stack is empty, transfer all inputs to reverse their order; pop and peek from the output stack.

choices.label: Pop directly from the input stack whenever it is nonempty.
choices.feedback: That returns the newest queued value before older values.
